entries.quote: We believe that state-of-the-art AI training model costs are likely to increase 100-fold, from roughly $1 million today to more than $100 million by 2025.
entries.metric: cost to train a state-of-the-art AI model
entries.subject: AI training cost

entries.quote: ARK estimates that data center spending on AI processors will scale more than four-fold during the next five years, from $5 billion a year today to $22 billion in 2025.
entries.metric: annual data center spending on AI processors
entries.subject: AI accelerators

entries.quote: ARK believes that deep learning will add ~$30 trillion to equity market capitalizations during the next 15-20 years.
entries.metric: global equity market capitalization created by deep learning
entries.subject: Deep learning

entries.idea: The Re-Invention of the Data Center
entries.quote: We believe that the combination of ARM and RISC-V will move from 0% market share in 2020 to 71% of the server market by 2030.
entries.metric: ARM and RISC-V share of the server market
entries.subject: Server processor architecture

entries.idea: The Re-Invention of the Data Center
entries.quote: For cloud computing, we believe ARM, RISC-V, and graphics processing units (GPUs) are likely to emerge as the new powerhouse processors. Together they could scale at a 45% annual rate to $19 billion in revenue by 2030.
entries.metric: data center CPU revenue from ARM and RISC-V
entries.subject: Server processor architecture
entries.note: p20 frames the same USD 19 billion as ARM and RISC-V CPU revenue.

entries.idea: The Re-Invention of the Data Center
entries.quote: In the data center, we believe accelerators, dominated by GPUs, will become the dominant processors for new workloads, growing 21% at an annual rate to $41 billion by 2030.
entries.subject: AI accelerators

entries.idea: The Re-Invention of the Data Center
entries.quote: According to ARK's research, by 2030 most developer PCs could be powered by ARM CPUs, marking the end of the Intel x86 era.
entries.subject: Developer PC processor architecture
entries.note: 'Most' read as more than 50%. Chart shows 75% (label placement ambiguous).

entries.idea: The Re-Invention of the Data Center
entries.quote: ARM server revenue could scale 100-fold, from less than $1 billion in 2020 to $100 billion in 2030, a level higher than x86 today.
entries.subject: Server processor architecture

entries.quote: According to our research, revenue from virtual worlds will compound 17% annually from roughly $180 billion today to $390 billion by 2025.
entries.subject: Virtual worlds revenue
entries.note: p27 headline: 'could approach $400 billion by 2025'.

entries.quote: According to our research, during the past 10 years in-game purchases as a percent of total gaming revenue increased from 20% to 75%. They could hit 95% by 2025.
entries.metric: in-game purchases share of total gaming revenue
entries.subject: In-game purchases

entries.quote: According to our research, the average time spent playing video games will increase from 1.1 hours per person per day to 1.5 hours during the next five years.
entries.metric: average time spent gaming per person per day
entries.subject: Time spent gaming
entries.note: Same slide: in-game revenue from about USD 130 billion (2020) to nearly USD 350 billion by 2025 if trends hold. Target year left null: only a relative horizon is stated.

entries.quote: ARK forecasts that by 2030 the AR market could scale from under a $1 billion today to $130 billion.
entries.subject: Augmented reality
entries.note: Footnote: consumer-based software revenues only.

entries.quote: Based on our research, the global gaming market will increase at a 16% compound annual rate during the next five years, from $175 billion in 2020 to roughly $365 billion by 2025.
entries.subject: Gaming market
entries.note: Same slide: AR and VR market from USD 3 billion to USD 28 billion in 2025.

entries.quote: ...compound annual rate during the next five years, from $3 billion to $28 billion in 2025.
entries.metric: global AR and VR market size
entries.subject: AR and VR market
entries.note: Sentence start is cut in the text layer; subject taken from the chart title 'Global AR & VR Market Size'.

entries.quote: According to ARK's research, digital wallets are valued between $250 and $1,900 per user today but could scale to $20,000 per user, representing a $4.6 trillion opportunity in the US by 2025.
entries.subject: Digital wallets
entries.note: p36: 230 million US digital wallet users by 2025 x USD 19,900 potential value per customer (conditional).

entries.quote: 230 Million Digital Wallet Users by 2025
entries.subject: Digital wallets

entries.quote: bank interest income on credit cards fell more than 10%, or roughly $16 billion in 2020 and is likely to drop more than 25% further, from $130 billion in 2019 to $95 billion by 2025.
entries.metric: US bank interest income on credit cards
entries.subject: Credit card interest income

entries.quote: As our analysis suggests, it could scale from roughly $500 billion to $1-5 trillion in network capitalization during the next five to ten years.
entries.subject: Bitcoin network value
entries.note: Stated range and window as published. Recorded as a stated fact only.

entries.quote: Based on Wright's Law, ARK forecasts that EV sales should increase roughly 20-fold from ~2.2 million in 2020 to 40 million units in 2025.
entries.subject: Electric vehicle sales
entries.note: p57: conditional on traditional automakers overcoming obstacles.

entries.quote: Automation could add 5%, or $1.2 trillion, to US GDP during the next five years. ARK believes automation will boost US real GDP growth by 100 basis points on average per year to 3.4%.
entries.metric: addition to US GDP from automation
entries.subject: Automation and GDP

entries.quote: ARK believes automation will boost US real GDP growth by 100 basis points on average per year to 3.4%.
entries.metric: average annual US real GDP growth, 2020-2025
entries.subject: US GDP

entries.quote: ARK's research suggests that autonomous ride-hailing platforms will generate more than $1 trillion in profits per year by 2030. In addition, automakers and fleet owners could enjoy profits of $250 billion and $70 billion, respectively.
entries.metric: annual profits of autonomous ride-hailing platforms
entries.subject: Autonomous ride-hailing profits
entries.note: p71: operating earnings; automakers about USD 250 billion and fleet owners about USD 70 billion per year by 2030.

entries.quote: Likewise, autonomous ride-hailing could generate 50% margins, but its lower price point should expand the total market from $150 billion in revenues with take rates up to 60%, to $6-7 trillion by 2030.
entries.subject: Autonomous ride-hailing revenue

entries.quote: If Tesla launches its autonomous ride-hailing service successfully in 2022, ARK estimates adoption could approach 20% by 2025.
entries.subject: Autonomous ride-hailing adoption
entries.note: Conditional. Same slide: ARK assigns a 30% probability to a successful Tesla launch; if Waymo or GM succeed instead, adoption probably limited to 1% during the next five years.

entries.quote: Enterprise value for autonomous platform operators could scale to 3.8T by 2025.
entries.metric: enterprise value of autonomous ride-hailing platform operators
entries.subject: Autonomous ride-hailing market value

entries.quote: While not yet commercialized, ARK estimates that drone delivery platforms will generate nearly $50 billion in revenues, $14 billion in hardware sales, and $3 billion in mapping revenues by 2025.
entries.subject: Drone delivery
entries.note: Same sentence: USD 14 billion hardware sales and USD 3 billion mapping revenue by 2025.

entries.quote: By 2030, drone delivery platforms could scale another four-fold, generating ~$275 billion in revenues, while hardware sales grow nearly three-fold to almost $50 billion, and mapping revenues nearly four-fold to $12 billion.
entries.subject: Drone delivery
entries.note: Repeats the 2020 edition's 2030 figures.

entries.quote: The market for connected planes, trains, and motor vehicles is likely to reach $36 billion in 2025.

entries.quote: ARK believes 3D printing will revolutionize manufacturing, growing at an annual rate of roughly 60% from $12 billion last year to $120 billion in 2025.

entries.quote: ARK estimates that drone hardware revenues will total roughly $100 billion by 2025.
